# `domain/types.ts`

This module defines the core domain types, interfaces, constants, and utility functions used throughout the application. It provides canonical values for task statuses, types, sizes, workflows, and visibility levels, along with shared data structures for sessions, worktrees, reviews, and worker results.

## Interfaces

### `SessionUser`

Represents an authenticated user within a session.

```ts
import { SessionUser } from '...'
```

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | Internal numeric user identifier. |
| `entraOid` | `string` | Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) object identifier. |
| `email` | `string` | User's email address. |
| `displayName` | `string` | User's display name. |
| `role` | `string` | User's assigned role. |

**Example:**
```ts
const user: SessionUser = {
  id: 42,
  entraOid: "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx",
  email: "user@example.com",
  displayName: "Jane Doe",
  role: "admin",
};
```

---

### `TaskFilters`

Defines optional filter criteria for querying tasks.

```ts
import { TaskFilters } from '...'
```

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status?` | `string` | Filter by a single task status. |
| `statuses?` | `string[]` | Filter by multiple task statuses. |
| `repoId?` | `number` | Filter by repository ID. |
| `createdBy?` | `number` | Filter by the ID of the user who created the task. |
| `search?` | `string` | Free-text search string. |
| `visibility?` | `string` | Filter by task visibility. |

**Example:**
```ts
const filters: TaskFilters = {
  statuses: ["pending", "queued"],
  visibility: "public",
  search: "auth bug",
};
```

### `WorktreeInfo`

Describes a Git worktree associated with a task.

```ts
import { WorktreeInfo } from '...'
```

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | Filesystem path of the worktree. |
| `branch` | `string` | Branch checked out in the worktree. |
| `repoFullName` | `string` | Full repository name (e.g., `owner/repo`). |
| `provider` | `string` | Git hosting provider (e.g., `github`). |
| `createdAt` | `Date` | Timestamp when the worktree was created. |
| `baseSha` | `string` | SHA of the commit the feature branch was created from. Used for diffing. |
| `recovered?` | `boolean` | `true` when `createWorktree` checked out an existing remote branch instead of creating a new one. |

